title: Flagella
body: Flagellin has to be secreted. It builds filaments at the pole or side it was sent to, and a stronger amount grows a longer tuft or adds another filament. The flagellar motor has to be embedded in the membrane at that same site. A filament with no motor only hangs there.

The motor does not spin evenly. It whips for part of a beat, then rests, and the cell tumbles in the gap. A trace of motor protein beats about every second and a half. Hyperexpression stretches one beat out to about sixteen seconds. Q and E nudge the heading while the motors run. An empty ATP pool stalls them.
